title: € (Euro27)
description: Adds money (€/c), a banking system and more!
body:
This mod can be used to make an extensive money and currency system on servers.

It is based on the European currency **Euro (€ and c)**.

This is my newest and best mod yet.



**Euro27 adds:**

- a player bound banking system
- **€** coins and bills (1€, 2€, 5€, 10€, 20€, 50€, 100€, 200€, 500€)
- **c** coins (1c, 2c, 5c, 10c, 20c, 50c)
- a **credit card** (is used to access money)
- a bank block (can transfer money to credit card and back)
- a **wallet** (can store money and a credit card)
- a payment terminal (outputs redstone signals if a specific amount is payed)
- a key (is used by the owner of a payment terminal to change the payment amount and transfer money)
- **crafting** recipes for all items (money can't be crafted, 100€ is added if a credit card is crafted)
